simple.summary: אֶלְנַעַם (ʼElnaʻam) means Elnaam , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 46.

definitions.full: H493. Elnaam אֶלְנָ֑עַם proper name, masculine ( God is pleasantness ) father of two of David's heroes 1Chr 11:46 (not in Samuel).
